subject.title: fix(agents): use fetchWithSsrFGuard in minimax-vlm.ts instead of raw fetch

question: Should MiniMax VLM inherit the canonical provider transport rule that trusts an operator-configured base URL origin while retaining metadata/link-local exclusions and the explicit allowPrivateNetwork override?
rationale: The implementation is internally consistent, but accepting configured private origins and trusted proxy DNS changes the outbound security boundary and is an intentional operator-trust policy choice.

options.title: Adopt canonical provider policy
options.body: Preserve configured MiniMax endpoint compatibility by using the same trusted-origin and private-network semantics as other provider transports.

options.title: Require stricter private access
options.body: Hold the PR and require an explicit private-network opt-in for local or private MiniMax endpoints, accepting a compatibility change from current custom-endpoint behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt canonical provider policy
recommendation.body: Preserve configured MiniMax endpoint compatibility by using the same trusted-origin and private-network semantics as other provider transports.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the adjacent trusted-proxy guard behavior and have recent MiniMax provider decision history.
